title: Essential crew socks
body_html:
The  finishing touch to every fit.

The Essential crew socks are crafted for all-day comfort with  a soft cotton-rich construction and supportive fit. designed a classic crew length, they're equally at home on the course, in the clubhouse or as part of your everyday wardrobe.

Finished with signature Goldenhour logo, they're a simple essential that completes every outfit.

bulit for on &. off the course!

title: Essential Quarter Socks
body_html:
Everyday comfort, in a shorter fit.

The Essential Quarter Socks are crated from a soft cotton-rich fabric with a supportive fit that's built formal-day wear. The shorter quarter length offers a clean, understated look while delivering the same comfort and performance as. the crew version.

Finished with the signature Goldenhour logo, they're an everyday essential designed complete every outfit.

Built for on & off the course.

title: The Essential Cap
body_html:
A  timeless essential.

Crafted from durable premium canvas, The Essential Cap blends classic styling with everyday versatility.The non structured six-panel silhouette offers a clean., effortless fit, while the embroidered G logo on the front and subtle Golden Hour script on the side adds the finishing touches.

Designed to age beautifully with wear, it's the perfect companion whether you're heading to the first tee, travelling for the. weekend or enjoying an evening in the sun.

An everyday staple, built to go wherever the day takes you.

Built for on & off the course!

A Stripe Pique Polo is crated from premium 100% cotton pique, offering a breathable feel and relaxed fit that's built f or everyday wear. Finished with a contrast collar, timeless stripe detailing and signature Golden Hour embroidery. It's a piece that feels just as comfortable on. the first tee as it does long after the final putt.

Finished with a crisp contrast collar and subtle Golden Hour embroidery, it's understated, versatile and easy to style - whether you're teeing it up or heading out afterwards.

title: Double Pleated Shorts
body_html:
A modern take on a timeless silhouette.

The Double Pleated Shorts are d designed with comfort and effortless style in mind. Cut with relaxed, baggy fit and finished with a classic double pleat, they offer a clean, elevated look that works just as well on the course as it does off it.

Crafted from a lightweight blend of polyester, bamboo fibre and spandex, they're breathable, soft and made to keep you cool throughout the summer. The screen-printed Golden Hour logo adds a subtle finishing touch, while the generous fit gives you room to move all day.

We recommend sizing down or wearing with a belt.

After all...who doesn't love baggy pair of shorts?

Built for on & off the course.

  • Relaxed baggy fit
  • double pleated front
  • lightweight & breathable
  • screen-printed Golden Hour Logo on back pocket
  • soft stretch fabric 
  • sandy/cream colour way

Finished with premium detailing throughout, this piece is made for early morning starts, breezy twilight rounds, and everyday wear off the course. A versatile layer that covers every basis — wherever you choose to wear it.

title: Clubhouse Waffle Polo
body_html:
A classic made modern 

The clubhouse waffle polo speaks for itself - a beautifully textured waffle in a rich brown shade, pairs with clean cream screen-printed Golden hour branding on the front and across the back. Designed to deliver warmth and comfort with sacrificing style, weather your on the course, at the range or out for the day.

The structured collar, premium buttons and tailored fit give it a refined, elevated look. Warm, breathable and effortlessly stylish - this is the polo you'll keep reaching for all season long.

model 6ft1 wears medium

  • designed for on course performance and every day wear

title: The Ripstop Layer
body_html:
Warmth without the bulk.

Our cotton-filled. nylon ripstop half-zip is designed to keep you warm, comfortable and looking sharp all year long. The lightweight fill gives you insulation without the. heavy feel, while the durable ripstop exterior adds structure and longevity. Wear  the collar up or down to switch between a sharp, structured look or a  relaxed, casual finish.

model 6ft1 wears large

 

Features 

  • Cotton-filled for lightweight warmth
  • Durable nylon ripstop outer shell
  • Front & back screen print details
  • Two functional front pockets
  • White contrast stitching 
  • Half-zip closure 
  • Versatile collar - wear up or folded down
  • 90% nylon 10% spandex

title: The Ripstop Pants
body_html:
Built from the same cotton-filled nylon ripstop as the top, theses trousers deliver warmth, comfort and all day wearability. The straight leg fit brings a clean silhouette, while the adjustable waist toggle and adjustable hem allow you to customise your fit.

Finished with two screen prints - one on the back pocket and one near the lower leg- for subtle statement detailing. With three pockets, including a perfectly sized back pocket ideal for your wallet or scorecard, theses pants are made for everyday practicality.

model 6f1 wears medium

Features 

  • Nylon ripstop with lightweight cotton filling
  • Two screen print details - back pocket + lower leg
  • Three pockets total 
  • Adjustable waistband toggle
  • Adjustable hem toggles for personalised style and fit
  • 90% nylon. 10% spandex

title: Golden Hour tote bag
body_html:
The golden hour nylon ripstop tote bag is built for everyday use. - lightweight, durable and clean in. all the right ways. Crafted from. tough nylon ripstop, it holds shape while. staying flexible enough for daily essentials.

A secure front zip pocket keeps your valuables safe and easy to reach, while minimalist Golden hour branding delivers  a sleek, understated finish. whether you're heading to. the clubhouse or out for the day. This tote is designed to. look good while keeping your essentials organised.

Features 

  • Durable nylon ripstop fabric
  • Lightweight, everyday carry design
  • Secure front pocket for valuables 
  • Minimal golden hour branding
  • Comfortable straps 
  • Clean, timeless silhouette
